title: Headless The Finger of Suspicion (VMS33): Vulpes Inculta at the Fort sends the player to protect Martina Groesbeck; the Omerta thugs talked off (Speech 50); Vulpes pays (stage 100)

actions.text: Path: at the Fort Vulpes Inculta tells of Martina Groesbeck, a Legion informant on the Strip the Omertas mean to kill, and sends the player to her (stage 10: Martina and the thugs enabled at the Vault 21 gift shop); the lead thug is told the Legion protects her (Speech 50, given: stage 50, objective 30); back at the Fort Vulpes is told they left (speechsuccess: stage 100, Legion fame). The other ways: the thugs killed (30, then 100), Martina dead (40), Vulpes killed (110, fail). Given: Caesar met (VDialogueCaesar FirstTalk; until then Vulpes only says Caesar awaits); the legion chain walks that meeting.
Stand-in for the trip to the Fort and the walk to Vulpes Inculta.
Stand-in for the trip to the Strip's Vault 21 gift shop, where the thugs corner Martina.
Stand-in for the trip back to the Fort.
